key_insight: (MPO)^2 learns compact multivariate polynomial models by combining MPO-based feature embeddings with structured polynomial weight tensors, improving expressivity without exponential tensor growth.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical way to build efficient, order-independent polynomial approximators for machine learning and signal-processing pipelines under tight memory and compute budgets.
method: Learn MPO feature embeddings to represent inputs compactly.
Use polynomial weight tensors with structured operators such as projections, convolutions, and masks.
Preserve feature-order independence while enabling compact multiplicative interactions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improvements over existing tensor-decomposition-based polynomial models across regression and classification benchmarks.
watch_item: Performance may depend on correct MPO/weight-tensor design, and structured constraints could add implementation complexity.
paper_title: (MPO)$^2$: Multivariate Polynomial Optimization based on Matrix Product Operators
